title: If CMS Doesn't Cover Revolutionary Depression Care it--Might Be Your Fault?!?
subtitle: Leave a comment. Change the world!
text:
Look. The time is now. If you've ever wanted insurance to cover remarkable treatment for depression? If you don't leave a comment in the next nine days, I'm gonna blame you, personally.

This a joke. But it's also important to understand that open comments are the most important power that you didn't know you had.

Yeah, insurance won’t cover revolutionary treatments. However, the NTAP changes that if we leave comments.

This is our moment. Here is the link:

https://www.federalregister.gov/documents/2023/05/01/2023-07389/medicare-program-proposed-hospital-inpatient-prospective-payment-systems-for-acute-care-hospitals

Re: SAINT Neuromodulation NTAP Coverage

Dear Sir/Madam,

I am writing to express my unequivocal support for the coverage of SAINT Neuromodulation under the New Technology Add-On Payment (NTAP) program. As someone who closely follows advances in neuroscience and psychiatric treatments, the impact of this decision could not be more crucial. It represents a watershed moment in the future of mental health care and holds significant implications for the millions of Americans who suffer from depression.

I have carefully reviewed various reports by respected authorities in the field, such as Owen Muir, MD, and found compelling evidence that supports the efficacy of SAINT Neuromodulation as a treatment for depression. His work published on Frontier Psychiatrists, along with coverage on popular media platforms like The Today Show and the Huberman Lab Podcast, highlight the game-changing potential of this treatment. It is not an overstatement to say that the capacity of SAINT Neuromodulation to achieve depression remission without the use of medications could revolutionize our approach to mental health treatment.

Depression, as a leading cause of disability worldwide, demands our most innovative and effective solutions. The standard treatments that currently exist, including pharmacotherapies and psychotherapy, are undeniably valuable but they do not fully meet the needs of all patients. This is particularly true for those who are treatment-resistant or who cannot tolerate the side-effects of antidepressant medications. For these individuals, SAINT Neuromodulation could be a much-needed lifeline.

As a society, it is our moral obligation to ensure the best available healthcare solutions reach as many of those in need as possible. NTAP coverage of SAINT Neuromodulation could help democratize access to this promising therapy, thereby improving the quality of life for countless individuals suffering from depression.

Given the breadth of evidence that underlines the effectiveness of SAINT Neuromodulation and its potential to transform the field of psychiatry, I urge you to consider granting NTAP coverage to this ground-breaking treatment. Doing so would indeed be a great stride towards a more inclusive, innovative, and effective healthcare system that truly serves the needs of its users.

Thank you for your attention to this important matter. I sincerely hope the Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services will seize this unique opportunity to play a leading role in the advancement of mental health care.

Sincerely,

[Your Name]
